purpose: Permit MAIN-side hostile review of the proposed HPADJ-08, N401+EX5, and CUT theorem-mining directions without duplicating active specialist research or changing mathematical authority.

findings.proposed_direction: Retain support/orbit quadratic moments and Picard64 parity instead of applying only the coarse group-Cauchy inequality.
findings.reason: The live MAIN research branch already retains the stronger rational Schur-complement and integral finite-quotient lower-bound kernels as GRF-04 and GRF-05. The missing work is a concrete current-population adapter/application owned by 178, not another MAIN theorem schema.
required_before_use: hostile audit and authoritative retention of the GRF-04/05 kernel source locks
source-locked map from each selected terminal to the full quadratic-form variables and retained parity constraints
exact noncredit survivor-impact replay before any estimate of a 10^21 to 10^22 saving
overlap and double-charge accounting against HPADJ-07 and every consumed CUT

findings.proposed_direction: Promote coarse invariants to parity classes and prove Picard64 completion impossible class by class.
findings.reason: N401 hostile audit accepts 97 retained blocks, 5459 survivors, 66 classes for (a,b,b-c,wave), and zero parity conflicts. It grants no pruning and proves no transport beyond those 97 blocks. Existing MAIN synthesis explicitly leaves population identity, coordinate-label equivalence, affine relation-space equivalence, and EX5 structural origin unproved.
required_before_use: exact N401-to-EX5 population intersection or embedding certificate
source-locked coordinate/covector adapter; matching integer labels are not an adapter
proof that required parity determines Picard64 completion UNSAT rather than only class membership
uniformity proof for every claimed FULL178 class and explicit exceptions
overlap accounting before any numerical or MAIN credit

findings.proposed_direction: Use CUT UNSAT outputs to mine source-locked finite-ring, HNF, or parity invariants that close whole parent families.
findings.reason: CUT201 records 209 whole-block finite-ring UNSAT blocks, 9 all-HNF-parent finite-ring UNSAT blocks, 8 empty HNF-parent populations, and 29 nonclosing blocks. This is suitable labeled data for invariant extraction, but the retained handoff is still candidate-only and has not proved a family-level implication.
required_before_use: hostile audit of CUT201 exact result and recovery provenance
predeclared feature universe and train/holdout split across disjoint audited CUT waves
extracted invariant stated as a universally quantified necessary-condition lemma
independent replay on held-out blocks and proof-level derivation; empirical zero conflicts alone are insufficient
explicit adapter before transporting an e=8 g1-d008 CUT invariant to another population

findings.proposed_direction: Close the remaining upper-bound population uniformly by proving surviving numerical terminals cannot realize actual integral irreducible carriers.
findings.reason: The current terminal count is an upper bound rather than an exact residual identity set, so a uniform nonrealization theorem can close a downstream receiver without enumerating every terminal. It still requires explicit population-to-carrier, effectivity, integrality, irreducibility, normalization, branch, and endpoint adapters and cannot inherit HPADJ/CUT numerical credit.

main_audit_decision.reason_estimate_not_supported: No exact current-population replay of the sharpened quadratic kernel has been produced. The magnitude is a research hypothesis, not retained evidence.
main_audit_decision.reason_no_demand_created: This PR is an audit handoff. Operational reprioritization must occur on the live current MAIN authority after exact-head audit and stale-state reconciliation.
